# IV Studio

> A free desktop app for making short films with MiniMax H3, where you hunt quick previews, finish the best shot at full size, and cut pictures, songs and voices together into an export.

Runs on Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux (AppImage), driving your own ComfyUI locally, with optional rendering on RunPod, Modal or Comfy Cloud. Includes a chat with your own Claude Code, Codex or Hermes agent, an MCP server for external agents like Claude Desktop, an editor, and a History and Activity log with undo. Current version is 1.1.7; terms of use include MiniMax use restrictions accepted before your first H3 render.

## Docs

- [IV Studio](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hollisorg/iv-studio/main/README.md): Free open-source desktop app for making short films with MiniMax H3, driving your own ComfyUI and latest 1.1 changes.
- [IV Studio terms of use and acceptable use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hollisorg/iv-studio/main/TERMS.md): Terms of use for IV Studio and MiniMax H3: age, consent, harassment, deception and AI disclosure rules users must accept.
- [Terms paragraph for release and download notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hollisorg/iv-studio/main/docs/release-notes-terms.md): Ready-made terms paragraph for pasting into release notes and download pages, with licence facts and misuse report email.
- [IV Studio safeguards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hollisorg/iv-studio/main/docs/SAFEGUARDS.md): Safeguards against misuse of MiniMax H3: how the app's protections work, report handling and code-reviewed safeguards.
